question: In December 2020, which of the following states launched a campaign called ‘Varasat’ to curb property and land-related disputes in rural areas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** government has launched a **special campaign to curb property & land-related disputes** in rural areas.
 
• This is a first of its kind campaign to **end the nagging land-related** issues in the** rural areas**.
 
• It aims to eradicate the exploitation of the villagers in the name of 'Varasat' of land and property.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• This **special campaign** will continue till **15th February** next year. 
 
• After the **'Varasaat' exercise, **people will get **proper paper documents of their land property** and get loans from banks.
 
• This will also help minimise disputes and animosity within families and relatives.
 
• The people would also** get rid of facing lawsuits** that sometimes trail for generations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uttar Pradesh:**

 
 
• **​Chief Minister:** Yogi Adityanath
 
• **Governor: **Anandiben Patel 
 
• **Capital:** Lucknow
